overview:
**High fire danger persists today, driven by dry fuels with ERC at the 80th percentile and BI at 75th.**
- Danger stays High all week, with ERC climbing to the mid-80s percentile by Sept 3-5.
- A Flood Watch is in effect through midnight tonight for the area, with scattered showers/thunderstorms and gusty southwest winds possible today into Monday.
- No local watchout thresholds are currently triggered (0 of 7), and no Red Flag Warning is posted.
- Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests are under Stage 1 fire restrictions, while Gunnison County remains in Stage 2, meaning no open burning or campfires.
- BLM Uncompahgre Field Office Stage 1 restrictions cover Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, and Delta counties.
- Two uncontained fires remain active nearby: the Elk Fire (7,257 acres, 64% contained) northwest of Lake City with minimal behavior, and the Gold Mountain Fire (39,744 acres, 87% contained) north of Ouray, still threatening energy infrastructure.
